title: Terrarium
summary: A small sealed terrarium that keeps living, even while the app is closed
description: A fish-tank-sized sealed terrarium: moss, ferns, fittonia, pilea, peperomia, baby tears and creeping fig, with springtails, isopods, fungus gnats, aphids, ladybugs and a jumping spider going about their day. The grow light follows your local time, and the tank keeps living while the app is closed: the next time you open it, the time away plays back as a short time-lapse (G skips it). Mist, seed, prune or switch off the light; knock the device and the bugs startle. Summary and Journal pages track every species over the days. Smooth 30 fps with anti-aliased graphics on all four cores; no network access needed. A port of the Cardputer ADV terrarium firmware.
